# Document templates

Reusable templates for AI Tray documentation. Prefer these over inventing new
shapes.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [ADR_TEMPLATE.md](ADR_TEMPLATE.md) | New Architecture Decision Records under `docs/adr/` |
| [../dogfood/bug-triage-template.md](../dogfood/bug-triage-template.md) | Dogfood bug triage |
| [../dogfood/issue-template.md](../dogfood/issue-template.md) | Dogfood issue notes |
| [../dogfood/feedback-checklist.md](../dogfood/feedback-checklist.md) | Feedback capture |

GitHub Issue/PR templates live under [`.github/`](../../.github/).
